Contributing
============

We love contributions. This project follows the
[Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/) (DCO).

Sign your work
--------------

All commits must be signed off. Use `git commit --signoff` so that every
commit message ends with a `Signed-off-by:` line.

Tests
-----

Tests are not required for documentation-only changes. For code changes,
please add tests that cover the new behaviour.

Release notes
-------------

Maintainers will update the release notes when cutting a release, so you
don't need to touch `CHANGES.md`.
